title: Non-Billable highlights findings from Burford Capital's London Disputes Report 2026
summary: Non-Billable highlights findings from Burford Capital's London Disputes Report 2026. Learn more.
body_markdown:
An article published by Non-Billable explores findings from Burford Capital's[London Disputes Report 2026](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/insights-research/2026-the-london-disputes-report/) examining how general counsel and law firms approach commercial litigation. Drawing on research involving 100 UK legal professionals, the article highlights the growing influence of litigation costs, duration and enforcement risk on decisions to pursue or settle disputes.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.nonbillable.co.uk/partner-insights/what-gcs-law-firms-say-about-litigation-2026)
